name: Button
description: Primary actions, secondary CTAs, form buttons, and small interface controls.
accessibility: Native button element with visible focus states and disabled styles.

name: Badge
description: Status labels, tier labels, release tags, and small metadata chips.
accessibility: Decorative text label. Use clear text and do not rely on color alone for meaning.

name: Card
description: Content grouping, settings panels, feature cards, and basic layout shells.
accessibility: Semantic wrapper is flexible; choose article/section outside if needed for document structure.

name: Input
description: Text fields for forms, waitlists, search boxes, and settings screens.
accessibility: Use a visible label or aria-label. Focus ring and disabled state are included.

name: Textarea
description: Long-form input for feedback, contact forms, support messages, and notes.
accessibility: Use a visible label or aria-label. Resize is enabled vertically by default.

name: Basic Dialog
description: Accessible confirmations, lightweight forms, and simple product messages.
props: Current MVP exports a ready demo component
accessibility: Radix handles focus trap, ESC close, outside click, and ARIA dialog semantics.

name: Floating Island Navbar
description: Landing page nav, portfolio nav, section switcher.
accessibility: Uses semantic nav, visible focus states, and horizontal overflow fallback on small screens.

name: Morph Modal
description: CTA, signup modal, feature preview, gallery modal.
props: Current MVP exports a ready demo component
Next: controlled content slots and trigger prop
accessibility: ESC close, click outside close, labelled content, focus handling from Radix Dialog.

name: Magnifier Dock
description: Social links, quick actions, portfolio launcher.
accessibility: Icon anchors include aria-label and focus rings; touch screens fall back to fixed icon sizes.

name: Color Orbit Card
description: Feature highlight, premium pricing card, product stat, or launch announcement card.
accessibility: Uses semantic article content and visible focus state on CTA; animation is decorative only.

name: Animated Pricing Card
description: Pricing card with featured-tier emphasis, hover lift, glow, and checklist structure.
accessibility: Uses semantic article content and a clear CTA link with focus state.

name: Spotlight Card
description: Cursor-follow highlight card with a soft spotlight that reacts to pointer movement.
accessibility: Animation is decorative. CTA has visible focus state and touch devices use a safe static fallback.
